department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Your child gets a free hot breakfast at school, Monday to Friday, on school working days. Dishes include upma, kichadi, pongal and kesari.

other: Your child studies in a Tamil Nadu government school.
Your child is in Class 1 to Class 5.
The scheme was also extended to some government aided schools in rural areas in 2024-25.

how_to_apply: You do not need to apply. Your child gets the breakfast at school.

evidence.quote: by the Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment of the Tamil Nadu Government
Free Breakfast will be distributed daily from Monday to Friday on School Working Days.
Students should be Studying in the Government of Tamil Nadu Schools.
Students of Class 1st to Class 5th will only be eligible.
The scheme has been extended to 4154 Government Aided Schools in rural areas during 2024-2025.
There is no need to apply anywhere for the Tamil Nadu Government's Chief Minister Breakfast Scheme.
Student will get the breakfast (scheme benefits) at their school.

gaps: No helpline or G.O. number on the saved pages.
